Retail sales as specified in this section shall be con-
strued to mean sales made to ultimate consumers;

The maximum ceiling prices for retailers of arti-
oles, commodities and merchandise, imported into the Philip-
pines under the provisions of the preceding section, shall be
computed on the basis of the landed cost of any specific com-
modity plus a margin of profit not exceeding the mark-up
prescribed in Section 2 hereof.
The term "landed cost" shall
consist of the CIF valued at Manila or any other port of land-
ing, plus expenses for arrastre, brokerage, handling, dis-
charge, banking and cable charges, insurance against theft
ana bilferage: and delivery expenses.

The Philippine Relief and Rehabilitation Adminis-
tration, through its agents in the Price Control Division,
shall have the power to examine and investigate invoices,
books, records, and accounts of any importer, wholesaler or
retailer for the purpose of computing or determining the ceil-
ing prices of any imported artiole, commodity or merchandise.

For all places outside the City of Manila or out-
side the territorial jurisdiction of the port of landing, the
ceiling prices of articles or commodities specified in Section
1 hereof, or all artioles the maximum retailers' price of which
are to be computed in accordance with Section 3 heredf, shall
be increased by a reasonable amount per unit representing actual
transportation and handling expenses and other necessary and
unavoidable expenses incurred or to be incurred by the retailer
in taking the goods to the place of resale.

- 9 -
No article or commodity which is raised, produced or manu-
retured in the Philippines shall be sold in the City of Manila
a price in excess of the maximum fixed for the same or simi-
or imported article or commodity.
In the center of production
• manufacture of locally made products or articles, or in va-
Lous places or areas where products of the Philippines are
raised, grown, produced or manufactured, the maximum selling
ice shall be ten per centum (10%) less than the maximum sell-
lag price fixed for the same or similar articles in the dity of
In areas or places where articles or commodities of the
Shilippines are not raised, grown or produced; the maximum sell-
ing price shall be the maximum selling price for the same or
Similar article or commodity in the City of Manila, plus ten
per centum (10) thereof, plus actual expenses for transporta-
tion, handlins, and other expenses to the place where the said
article is to be sold or consumed which, in no case, shall not
exceed ten per centum (10%) of the maximum selling price thus
dixed for the same or similar article in the City of Manila.

There is hereby created a Price Fixing Committee
so be. composed or the Secretary of Agriculture and Commerce as
the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Health
and Public Welfare, and two representatives of the duly organized
chambers of commerce in the City of Manla, as members. The
rice Fixing Co mitte shall have the power to increase or de-
grease the price ceilings herein specified, or provide a higher
or lower mark-up for wholesalers or retailers, depending upon
changes in the cost of production, manufacture, transportation,
and other factors affecting prices, provided that the retailer
Shall have a margin or profit of not less than 10% nor more than
15% over the operating expenses.

Any person who shall refuse to sell any article,
commodity or merchandise displayed in his store or place of
business, where a maximum selling price is fixed, shall be
punished in accordance with the provisions of Section 3 of
Commonwealth Act No. 600, as amended.

All. retailers or vendors of articles, commodi-
ties or merchandise, inside or outside of the public markets,
are hereby required to post in a conspicuous place, at the
entrance of theis stores, or within said premises, a list of
all the articles being sold by them with their respective re-
tail selling prices.
In addition, all such, retailers or ven-
dors are hereby ordered to place within plain view of the
buying public price tags on all articles or commodities of-
fered for sale or displayed on sale.

All Executive Orders and all EmergencynControl
Administration Orders or any of the provisions thereof which
are in conflict or inconsistent with this Order or any of its
provisions are hereby repealed.

This Executive Order shall take effect two davs
arter the date of its promulgation.
Done at the City of Manila, this 5thday of February, in
the year of Our Iord, nineteen hundred and forty-six, and of
the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the eleventh.
-SERGIO OSMENA
